class.name: CubismLipSyncProfile
class.description: Shared lip-sync envelope settings. Each CubismLipSync owns separate sample and envelope state. Numeric setters reject nonfinite or out-of-range values and retain the old setting. Mouth amplitude is additive; default maximum 0.8 matches the Native SDK sample weight. Authored parameters are protected unless blending is explicitly enabled.

members.member: Nonnegative gain applied to a unit-clamped amplitude after the noise gate.
Samples below this [0,1] threshold become silence before gain.
Nonnegative attack time constant in model seconds. Zero changes immediately.
Nonnegative release time constant in model seconds. Zero changes immediately.
Minimum additive output. Must be finite, representable as float and no greater than maximum.
Maximum additive output. Must be finite, representable as float and no less than minimum.
Empty uses manifest lip-sync IDs. Duplicate IDs apply once; missing IDs are skipped and reported.
Optional existing parameter receiving mouth_form_value. This takes precedence if also present in parameter_ids.
Fixed mouth-form value, subject to authored ownership and native bounds.
Allow envelope additions on parameters currently controlled by motions or expressions. Optional mouth form writes its fixed value when enabled.
